annotation.title_clean: Public Safety and Homeland Security Bureau Announces Addition of Uncrewed Aircraft Systems (UAS) and UAS Critical Components Produced Abroad, and Equipment and Services Listed in Section 1709 of the FY2025 NDAA, to FCC Covered List
annotation.title_en: Public Safety and Homeland Security Bureau Announces Addition of Uncrewed Aircraft Systems (UAS) and UAS Critical Components Produced Abroad, and Equipment and Services Listed in Section 1709 of the FY2025 NDAA, to FCC Covered List
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Federal Communications Commission, Public Safety and Homeland Security Bureau
named_instruments_referenced: Secure and Trusted Communications Networks Act
annotation.summary_en: FCC Public Safety and Homeland Security Bureau public notice adding foreign-produced uncrewed aircraft systems and critical components, plus FY2025 NDAA section 1709 equipment, to the Covered List following a national security determination. Covered equipment cannot receive FCC equipment authorization.
key_provisions_or_claims: Foreign-produced UAS and UAS critical components added to the FCC Covered List on Dec 22, 2025.
Covered equipment is barred from FCC equipment authorization, and applicants must certify non-covered status.
Exemptions are possible if the Department of War or DHS determines a given UAS or component poses no unacceptable risk.
The national security determination cites surveillance, data exfiltration, remote disabling and dual-use risks, and mass events like the World Cup.
Critical components include flight controllers, communications, navigation, batteries, motors, sensors and ground control stations.
